name: SoundCloud Go Plus
tagline: A consolation build is possible, but the paid product's decisive value sits outside a solo rebuild. For SoundCloud Go Plus, host and stream user-owned creator audio with comments on a private server. The hard boundary is creator network, licensed catalog, discovery, rights handling, uploads, and social graph, plus licensed content, rights, and distribution network.
